name: La Mojarra Stela 1
notes: Discovered 1986, Veracruz; bears a Long Count date. Justeson and Kaufman (Science 259, 1993) claimed a decipherment identifying the underlying language as pre-proto-Zoquean; Houston and Coe (Mexicon 25, 2003) argue the claimed decipherment imposes Mayan grammatical/spelling assumptions and failed an independent test against a separate Isthmian-script mask. This is a live, named two-camp dispute; see claim_epi_olmec_decipherment_disputed.
